authorization: User approved a quarantined pooled photo-level RBF Nyström M3-C extension after disclosure of prior outcome exposure.
model: P(A)=sigmoid(beta + w^T(phi(C_A)-phi(C_B))); one nonlinear scalar score per photo. No demographic or pet-care interactions.

kernel.type: RBF on original fitting-only centered/block-RMS CNN embeddings
kernel.gamma: multiplier divided by the median strictly positive squared Euclidean distance among unique fitting photos
kernel.landmarks: up to 256 unique fitting photos selected by ascending SHA-256 of UTF-8 'kernel-landmark-20261028:' + image_id; lexical tie
kernel.approximation: Nyström K(X,L) K(L,L)^(-1/2), symmetric eigendecomposition; clip eigenvalues below 1e-12 times largest eigenvalue to that floor
kernel.transforms: Fit CNN center/RMS, kernel bandwidth, landmarks, and Nyström center/RMS using unique fitting photos only; refit all transforms inside every learning-curve and G3/G4 fitting split.
kernel.leakage_guard: Held-out photos/cats cannot be fitting landmarks in G3/G4.

selection.tie_rule: within 1e-6 prefer larger ridge, then smaller bandwidth multiplier
selection.optimizer: original float64 analytic-gradient zero-start L-BFGS-B, with original retry and gradient <1e-5 acceptance
selection.loss: mean response-weighted stable logistic loss; intercept ridge 1e-6; coefficient ridge lambda
selection.freeze: Seal selected model and fitting-only transformations after validation selection, before reanalysis of already-saved test outcomes.

controls.investigation_trigger: 16 or more improvements or any failed fit

learning_curves.retune: all kernel widths and ridge values within each subset

test.confidence: 95% pointwise unadjusted; conditional on fitted models

limits: G2, G3, G4 outcomes and prior results have already been exposed. This is post-test exploratory, not independently confirmatory.
Width/landmark approximation and extra validation search differ from original linear M3-C; same populations and pair weighting do not eliminate selection optimism.
Kernel scorer retains scalar-ranking structure, does not identify causes or semantic preference effects.
G3 and G4 must be separately refitted on their own fitting splits; G3 resamples held-out photos and G4 held-out cats.
No frozen primary claim, original model, report, package or official prediction is modified or replaced.
